why: The budget `cargo xtask check-wasm` holds the shipped module to, both ways: over it fails, and so does more than 5% under it. `bytes` is what a browser compiles, `gzip` what it downloads. The module is the `compact` tier built with the workspace's `wasm` profile, its name section removed. Measured 2026-09-25 at 4 760 590 and 1 321 434; re-measured 2026-09-26 after the classical chart, the profiles, the Sthira and Yogardha dashas and the Jaimini reading at the boundary, at 1 350 299 gzipped on CI's Linux runner (the build is a little larger there than on macOS, 1 348 702) and 4 844 760 raw; each budget is 2% over, to the next ten kilobytes.
